quickstart.title: Quick Start
quickstart.intro: Welcome to Litewrite, a modern online LaTeX collaborative writing platform. Here's how to get started:
quickstart.step1Title: Create an account and log in
quickstart.step1Desc: Visit the homepage and click "Get Started" to register. We support email registration and Google/GitHub OAuth login.
quickstart.step2Desc: In the dashboard, click "New Project". You can start from a blank project or use an existing template (academic papers, resumes, presentations, etc.).
quickstart.step3Desc: In the editor, the left panel shows the file tree, the center is the code editor, and the right shows the PDF preview. The system automatically compiles and updates the preview.
quickstart.step4Desc: Import paper source code from arXiv, clone repositories from GitHub, or directly upload ZIP files.

editor.title: Editor
editor.latexIntro: The editor is built on CodeMirror 6, providing a professional LaTeX editing experience:
editor.syntaxHighlight: Syntax highlighting: Complete LaTeX syntax coloring, distinguishing commands, environments, math formulas, etc.
editor.smartComplete: Smart completion: Type \ to trigger command completion, supporting document structure, math symbols, environments, etc.
editor.bracketMatch: Bracket matching: Automatically matches and highlights paired brackets and braces
editor.codeFold: Code folding: Supports folding \section, \begin...\end, and other structures
editor.lineNumbers: Line numbers: Click on line numbers to select the entire line
editor.searchReplace: Search & replace: Supports regex, case sensitivity, whole word matching, and more
editor.markdownIntro: In addition to LaTeX, the editor also supports Markdown file editing:
editor.markdownExtensions: Tables, task lists, and other extended syntax
editor.citationDesc: When typing inside \cite{}, the system automatically suggests citation entries from .bib files in your project. Search by author, title, year, etc. Press Ctrl+Shift+Space to open the advanced reference search panel.

ai.title: AI Features
ai.tapDesc: TAP (Type-Ahead Prediction) is a Ghost Text completion feature similar to Cursor. When you stop typing for about 400ms, AI analyzes the context and displays gray completion suggestions at the cursor position.
ai.tapNote: TAP can not only insert new content, but also suggest modifications to existing text (shown as strikethrough + gray new text).
ai.askDesc: Conversational AI assistant. Ask LaTeX syntax questions, request text polishing, translate content, etc. Use @ to reference the current file or selected code snippets as context.
ai.agentDesc: AI agent can autonomously plan and execute complex tasks: generate diagram code, create tables, batch modify files, etc. It shows the plan for your confirmation before execution.
ai.deepResearchDesc: Deep Research helps you conduct comprehensive research on a topic. AI will:
ai.deepResearch1: Perform multiple rounds of web searches based on your question
ai.deepResearchNote: The generated report can be copied directly into your LaTeX document.

pdf.title: PDF Preview
pdf.intro: Litewrite uses pdflatex for compilation by default, and you can choose other compilers (such as XeLaTeX, LuaLaTeX) in settings. Click the compile button in the toolbar or press Ctrl+S to trigger compilation, and the PDF preview on the right will update automatically after compilation.
pdf.controlZoom: Zoom: Use the +/- buttons in the toolbar or scroll wheel
pdf.controlPage: Page navigation: Enter page number or use up/down arrows
pdf.controlCompile: Manual compile: Click the compile button in the toolbar
pdf.synctexForward: Forward sync: Ctrl+click in the editor to jump to the corresponding position in PDF
pdf.synctexReverse: Reverse sync: Double-click text in PDF to jump to the corresponding source line
pdf.errorTip: Tip: If compilation fails, error messages will be displayed in the PDF preview area. Click on error messages to jump to the corresponding position in the source code.

collab.title: Real-time Collaboration
collab.intro: Litewrite supports multiple people editing the same project simultaneously. Collaboration is based on Yjs CRDT technology, ensuring no conflicts even with unstable network connections.
collab.editing1: Each collaborator has a unique cursor color, and you can see other people's cursor positions
collab.editing2: Selected text is highlighted in the collaborator's color
collab.editing3: The editor header shows avatars of currently online collaborators
collab.invite1: Click the "Share" button on the right side of the editor toolbar
collab.invite2: You can generate a share link or directly enter an email to invite
collab.invite3: After accepting the invitation, the project will appear in their dashboard
collab.permOwner: Owner: Full control, can delete project and manage collaborators
collab.permEditor: Editor: Can edit files and create versions, but cannot delete project
collab.permViewer: Viewer: Read-only access, can view and download

project.title: Project Management
project.filesIntro: The left file tree supports complete file and folder operations:
project.uploadDesc: Supports drag-and-drop upload, click upload button to select files, or upload ZIP files for automatic extraction. Supports images, PDFs, BibTeX, and other common file types.
project.exportDesc: Download the compiled PDF or package the entire project as a ZIP file.
project.importArxivDesc: Enter an arXiv ID (e.g., 2301.07041) or paper link, and the system will automatically download and extract the LaTeX source code.
project.importGithubDesc: Enter a GitHub repository URL, and the system will clone the repository content into a new project.
project.tagsDesc: Add tags to projects for easy categorization and filtering. Filter the project list by tags in the left sidebar of the dashboard.

version.title: Version History
version.intro: Litewrite supports manually creating version snapshots, making it easy to save project states at important milestones.
version.createDesc: Click the "Version History" button in the editor toolbar, then click "Create New Version". Enter a version name and description (optional), and the system will save a snapshot of all current files.
version.compareDesc: Select two versions to compare and view file additions, deletions, and modifications. Differences are shown line by line, with green for additions and red for deletions.
version.restoreDesc: Click the "Restore" button on a version to revert project files to that version's state. It's recommended to create a snapshot of the current state before restoring, in case you need to roll back.

templates.title: Templates
templates.intro: Litewrite provides rich LaTeX templates to help you quickly start writing.
templates.academicDesc: IEEE, ACM, Springer, and other journal formats
templates.thesisDesc: Bachelor's, Master's, and Doctoral thesis templates
templates.cvDesc: Professional resumes and academic CV templates
templates.customDesc: Save an existing project as a template: Click "Save as Template" in the project settings, fill in the template name, description, and category, and you can use it when creating new projects.

gettingStarted.intro: Litewrite is a modern, collaborative LaTeX platform that helps you create, edit, and share LaTeX documents with ease.

startWritingSteps.selectFile: Select the file you want to edit in the file tree on the left
startWritingSteps.writeLatex: Write LaTeX in the editor in the middle
startWritingSteps.previewPdf: View the compiled output in the preview panel on the right

inviteSteps.clickShare: Click the Share button in the top toolbar
inviteSteps.generateLink: Generate a share link or invite users directly
inviteSteps.realTime: Collaborators will see edits in real time

gettingStarted.chatText: Click the “Chat” tab in the left sidebar to discuss in real time with collaborators.

uploadImages.q: How do I upload images to a project?
uploadImages.a: Click the upload button in the file tree and choose an image file. PNG, JPG, and PDF are supported. After uploading, you can reference it with \\includegraphics.

compileFailed.a: Check the compile logs for the error details. Common causes include syntax errors, missing packages, and incorrect file paths.

chinese.q: How do I write Chinese content?
chinese.a: Use the XeLaTeX compiler and add \\usepackage{ctex}, or configure suitable fonts.

bibliography.q: How do I add a bibliography?
bibliography.a: Create a .bib file for references, then use \\bibliography{filename} and \\bibliographystyle{style} in your document.

conflicts.a: No. Litewrite uses CRDT-based real-time collaboration, so multiple people can edit the same file without losing content.

downloadPdf.q: How do I download the compiled PDF?
downloadPdf.a: Click the download button in the top-right of the PDF preview.
